full_page.content:
1935, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 64
Nov. 4 Little Boy or girl - 7 - wayward - prayed for some weeks ago - now doing well in school.
Two ladies ask prayers for health.
Nov. 6 Mary Sachse - 72 - Arthritis - hardening of arteries. Alveria Adamaszet - 19 - Threatened with T. B.
Irene Panfil - 42 - brain tuomer - operation To-day at 4 P.M. - En- rolled at 2:15 - 2 yrs. We'll trust in God.
Mrs. Agnes Totte - 36 - waiting five years and praying with husband and friends for family. Now expecting for nine months. Now for three days hopes suddenly vanish "no life". Husband promises if hopes re- vive, to go to holy Communion at least once a week instead of every two mo's
Page 65
Nov. 6 Mrs. Mary Ranger - 47 - lost her husband 1st March - her breast in June - now cancer seems coming back. Wants to live for two little ...
6 Amelia Felstone - 35 - fears stomach ulcers or cancer - 4 children & non c. husband.
6 Winifred Bentner - 20 - met with fearful bus accident - double frac- ture of skull, concussion of brain, hemorage, etc. This was last November. In June last had paralytic stroke. Last week was given up as hopeless - blood pressure 190. Her brother and Sister promised weekly Communion if she recovered ... She was sitting up next morning. Her face still crooked, Nov. 12th Here To-day OK - Except one eye & side of face slow. Enrolls as perpetual member - as promised for her Jan. 3 .... working every day ... Skating too ...
Mrs. Mary Marcon - 32 - invalid for 4 yrs. - has husband & 2 boys. Mrs. J. Derosier - sinus & Rhum ...
Jos. Derosier - p'rri'a & Rhum .. ..
Page 66 Nov. 6 Gertrude Russell - 28 - went to fortune-teller ... fears now lest she lose her mental faculties some way .....
